corpusSummary: Administrative determination acts (determinazioni) issued by Italian municipal offices, recording decisions such as public grants to businesses under PNRR-funded cultural regeneration programmes.

documentTopics.label: Grant disbursement
documentTopics.description: Documents ordering payment or disbursement (erogazione, saldo) of a public contribution to a beneficiary.

documentTopics.label: Business support
documentTopics.description: Measures sustaining entrepreneurial initiatives (sostegno di iniziative imprenditoriali, insediamento di nuove imprese).

documentTopics.label: Cultural regeneration
documentTopics.description: Projects for cultural, social and economic regeneration of historic villages and cultural sites (borghi, rigenerazione culturale, siti culturali).

documentTopics.label: PNRR / EU funding
documentTopics.description: References to PNRR missions, components, investments, NextGenerationEU or CUP-coded projects.

documentTopics.label: Public works
documentTopics.description: Documents under the Opere Pubbliche / technical department remit (Settore Tecnico, Patrimonio).

documentTopics.label: Municipal administration
documentTopics.description: Internal municipal determinations, responsibili del servizio, regolamenti and formal acts of the Comune.

documentTopics.label: Other
documentTopics.description: Catch-all for determinations not covered by the topics above.

entitySectors.label: Public administration
entitySectors.description: Municipalities and public bodies issuing the determinations (Comune, Città).

entitySectors.label: Private enterprise
entitySectors.description: Companies receiving contributions or setting up new businesses (impresa, nuove imprese).

entitySectors.label: Other
entitySectors.description: Catch-all for parties in other sectors.

entityRoles.label: Contribution beneficiary
entityRoles.description: Company receiving a grant or contribution (assegnatario di risorse, erogazione a saldo del contributo all'impresa).

entityRoles.label: Issuing official
entityRoles.description: The Responsabile del servizio signing the determination on behalf of the municipality.
